author: Brodie Robertson
description:
A few weeks back KDE announced that the new Plasma Login Manager was going to require the use of Systemd and thus wouldn't work on FreeBSD or the other BSDs and whilst this is true it's only about the Login Manager not the rest of KDE Plasma
